items.name: site-rebuilder
items.summary: Rebuilds a site-ripper SPEC as real code in this repo (Next 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, GSAP/Framer), adapted to DESIGN.md instead of copying the reference
items.whenToUse: Use when a spec is ready to implement, when the user wants to give the site a new spin, redo a section, port a layout or motion technique seen on another page, or says "apply that spec", "rebuild the projects section", or dice aplica el spec, "rehaz la sección", "dale un giro al sitio".

items.name: site-ripper
items.summary: Reverse-engineers web pages: drives the browser over a reference site and produces a structured SPEC (tokens, grid, typography, motion, copy, assets) ready for site-rebuilder to reconstruct in the target stack
items.whenToUse: Use when the user sends a URL and says replicate, clone, "I want something like this", reference, inspiration, awwwards, "how do they pull off this animation", or dice replicar, clonar, "quiero algo como", referencia, inspiración, "cómo hacen esta animación".

items.name: skills-cli
items.summary: Engineers the open-source `skills` CLI (Node 24 + TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies) that manages Claude Code skills, agents and plugins
items.whenToUse: Use when the user talks about the CLI, `skills <command>`, the manifest, publishing to npm, automating their setup, or dice el CLI, el manifest, "publicar en npm", "automatizar mi setup".

items.name: skillsmith
items.summary: Authors and curates Claude Code agent skills, subagents and plugins against the plugin/marketplace standard, so the whole collection updates with a single command
items.whenToUse: Use when the user says skill, agent, plugin, marketplace, distill, package, "turn this into a skill", talks about their ~/.claude setup, or dice destilar, empaquetar, "conviértelo en skill", "mis skills están sueltas".

items.name: lucas-core
items.summary: Lucas Leguizamo's own skills and agents: SEO blog articles for CONCAT, product discovery and PRDs, Excalidraw-style diagrams published over HTTPS, and the agents that author skills, build the CLI and reverse-engineer websites

items.name: concat-content
items.summary: Writes SEO blog articles for CONCAT (onconcat.com) as JSX ready to paste into lib/blog-posts.tsx, plus the nanobanana cover-image prompt, aimed at PyME (small-business) owners in Colombia and LATAM; the article itself is always written in Spanish
items.whenToUse: Use when the user says "write a post", "write an article", "create a blog post for CONCAT", "draft CONCAT content", "post about X", "what post is next on the calendar", or escribe un post / escribe un artículo / crea un post para el blog / redacta contenido para CONCAT / qué post sigue del calendario.

items.name: pm-agent
items.summary: Acts as a senior Product Manager: runs discovery with AskUserQuestion before writing anything, then delivers product vision, a prioritized backlog (RICE / MoSCoW), a feature filter, a full PRD or a sprint plan
items.whenToUse: Use when the user says "write me a PRD", "define the product", "build the backlog", "prioritize these features", "write user stories", "plan the sprint", or hazme un PRD / define el producto / arma el backlog / prioriza estas features / escribe user stories / planea el sprint.

items.name: whiteboard
items.summary: Draws flows, diagrams, wireframes and architecture maps in FigJam/Excalidraw style from Python (self-contained SVG + editable .excalidraw file + HTML viewer with pan/zoom) and publishes them to a private site behind nginx with Let's Encrypt TLS, a non-default port and a secret-token URL
items.whenToUse: Use when the user asks for a diagram, a flow, a wireframe, an architecture map, says "draw it", "make me a board", "publish it on a page", or dibújalo / hazme un diagrama / hazme un tablero / dibuja el flujo / mapa de arquitectura / publícalo en una página.
